destiny.January: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Elder Frost Dragon's arc bends toward temporal endurance — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. Born from the first snowfall of the universe, the Elder Frost Dragon watches over the passage of time from a throne of glacial silence.
destiny.February: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Storm Griffin's arc bends toward visionary insight — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. Legends place the Storm Griffin at the edge of every great change, wings cutting through the static before a new age is born.
destiny.March: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Moonlit Kraken's arc bends toward dream weaving — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. Where the ocean floor drops beyond any chart, the Moonlit Kraken keeps the archive of every dream ever surrendered to sleep.
destiny.April: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Flamehorn Ram's arc bends toward fearless ignition — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. The Flamehorn Ram is said to have lit the very first sunrise by charging headlong at the dark.
destiny.May: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Emerald Minotaur's arc bends toward unbreakable will — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. Deep in the oldest labyrinth, the Emerald Minotaur guards not a monster's secret but a garden — proof that strength and gentleness were never opposites.
destiny.June: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Twin-Tailed Sylph's arc bends toward duality's whisper — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. The Twin-Tailed Sylph is said to have been born of a single breath split into two winds, each pursuing a different horizon and neither wrong.
destiny.July: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Pearl Serpent's arc bends toward sacred protection — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. Coiled around the last shell of a sunken temple, the Pearl Serpent has guarded the same shoreline since the moon was new.
destiny.August: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Phoenix's arc bends toward immortality & rebirth — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. No creature in the twelve orders has died and returned more times than the Phoenix, and none wears its scars as ornaments quite so proudly.
destiny.September: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Whispering Sphinx's arc bends toward hidden truths — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. The Whispering Sphinx has guarded the same threshold since before roads led anywhere, testing every traveler with a question shaped exactly to their blind spot.
destiny.October: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Twilight Chimera's arc bends toward perfect balance — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. The Twilight Chimera was formed at the exact hour the sky can't decide between gold and violet, and has kept that indecision as its gift ever since.
destiny.November: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Shadow Basilisk's arc bends toward transformative venom — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. Few who meet the gaze of the Shadow Basilisk leave unchanged; fewer still leave unwilling to.
destiny.December: Zoomed out across a lifetime, the Starforged Wyvern's arc bends toward boundless wanderlust — the thread present in your first chapter is still present now, even where it's hard to see. The Starforged Wyvern was hatched from a star that refused to stay fixed in its constellation, and has been wandering ever since, forging new paths from scattered light.
